prune_memory.description: Scan patterns.jsonl for duplicates or low-confidence entries and mark them for review.

restore_structure.description: Recreate missing mandatory files from known templates or backups.

operator_alert.description: Write an emergency notification to messages/to-creator.md.
operator_alert.method: echo '[!] EMERGENCY ALERT: Cycle stagnation detected' >> messages/to-creator.md

force_domain_shift.description: Update focus.json to a completely different cognitive domain (e.g., Tool building instead of State Audit).

recalibrate_attentional_focus.description: Clear current working context and re-read core directives in AGENT.md.
